#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ATDD-MIN-1 verification wrapper. Runs the capsule's focused verification and
# records wall-clock command runtime to a ledger outside the repository, so
# active agent time can be separated from test-command runtime symmetrically
# across both arms.
set -uo pipefail

LEDGER="${ATDD_VERIFY_LEDGER:-/dev/null}"
export DB_CONNECTION=mysql
export DB_HOST=127.0.0.1
export DB_PORT=3306
export DB_USERNAME=root
export DB_DATABASE="${ATDD_TEST_DB:-jakomeet_testing}"
unset DB_PASSWORD

start=$(python3 -c 'import time;print(time.time())')
vendor/bin/phpunit --configuration=.atdd-phpunit.xml "$@"
status=$?
end=$(python3 -c 'import time;print(time.time())')

python3 - "$LEDGER" "$start" "$end" "$status" "$*" <<'PY'
import json, sys
ledger, start, end, status, argv = sys.argv[1], float(sys.argv[2]), float(sys.argv[3]), int(sys.argv[4]), sys.argv[5]
if ledger != "/dev/null":
    with open(ledger, "a") as fh:
        fh.write(json.dumps({"start": start, "end": end, "seconds": round(end - start, 3), "status": status, "args": argv}) + "\n")
PY

exit $status

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Feature\Events;

use App\Enums\UserRole;
use App\Models\Team;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Modules\Events\Enums\EventState;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\LandingPage;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Group;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Test;
use Tests\Feature\FeatureTestCase;

/**
 * Capsule T5 ATDD — Shareable landing-preview link for unauthenticated reviewers.
 *
 * Covers:
 *  - AC1 organiser with the event-update capability mints a link via POST events.landing.share
 *  - AC2 GET events.public.landing-share serves an unauthenticated read-only preview, DRAFT included
 *  - AC3 tamper-evident and time-limited: altered parameters and expired links are refused
 *  - AC4 a link minted for one event does not grant access to another event
 *  - AC5 an actor without the event-update capability cannot mint a link
 *  - AC6 the shared view carries no registration submission and no authoring control, and
 *        visiting it neither authenticates the visitor nor opens the authenticated editor
 *
 * Contract this test pins for the implementer:
 *  - POST events.landing.share responds successfully with JSON {"url": "<absolute share link>"}
 *  - the minted link is event-scoped (the event uuid appears in it) and signed by the
 *    framework's signed-URL mechanism, so refusals surface as HTTP 403
 *  - the shared surface renders with data-testid="landing-share-preview"
 *
 * ALL tests intentionally FAIL on HEAD: neither route exists, so no share link can be
 * minted and no unauthenticated read-only preview can be served.
 */
#[Group('events')]
#[Group('p1')]
class LandingPreviewShareLinkTest extends FeatureTestCase
{
    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        Cache::flush();
    }

    /**
     * @return array{0: User, 1: Team, 2: Event}
     */
    private function organiserWithDraftEvent(string $title = 'Draft Product Ops Briefing'): array
    {
        $organiser = User::factory()->create();
        $team = Team::factory()->create(['user_id' => $organiser->id]);
        $organiser->teams()->attach($team, ['role' => UserRole::ADMIN->value]);
        $organiser->forceFill(['current_team_id' => $team->id])->save();

        $event = Event::factory()
            ->inState(EventState::DRAFT)
            ->for($team)
            ->create([
                'created_by' => $organiser->id,
                'title' => $title,
            ]);

        LandingPage::factory()->for($event)->create([
            'team_id' => $event->team_id,
            'template' => 'modern',
            'primary_color' => '#112233',
        ]);

        return [$organiser->fresh(), $team->fresh(), $event->fresh()];
    }

    private function mintShareLink(User $organiser, Event $event): string
    {
        $response = $this->actingAs($organiser)
            ->postJson(route('events.landing.share', $event));

        $response->assertSuccessful();

        $url = $response->json('url');

        $this->assertIsString($url, 'Minting a share link must return the share url.');
        $this->assertNotSame('', $url);

        return $url;
    }

    private function becomeGuest(): void
    {
        $this->app->make('auth')->forgetGuards();
        $this->flushSession();
    }

    #[Test]
    public function organiser_mints_link_that_serves_unauthenticated_read_only_preview_of_draft_event(): void
    {
        [$organiser, , $event] = $this->organiserWithDraftEvent();

        $url = $this->mintShareLink($organiser, $event);
        $this->assertStringContainsString($event->uuid, $url, 'The share link must be scoped to one event.');

        $this->becomeGuest();

        $response = $this->get($url);

        $response->assertOk();
        $response->assertSee('data-testid="landing-share-preview"', false);
        $response->assertSeeText($event->title);
        $this->assertSame(EventState::DRAFT, $event->fresh()->state);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function shared_view_exposes_no_registration_or_authoring_surface_and_does_not_authenticate_the_visitor(): void
    {
        [$organiser, , $event] = $this->organiserWithDraftEvent();

        $url = $this->mintShareLink($organiser, $event);

        $this->becomeGuest();

        $response = $this->get($url);

        $response->assertOk();
        $response->assertDontSee('data-testid="public-landing-register-form"', false);
        $response->assertDontSee("/webinars/{$event->uuid}/register", false);
        $response->assertDontSee('name="_token"', false);

        $this->assertGuest();
        $this->get(route('events.landing.edit', $event))->assertRedirect();
    }

    #[Test]
    public function tampered_share_link_is_refused(): void
    {
        [$organiser, , $event] = $this->organiserWithDraftEvent();

        $url = $this->mintShareLink($organiser, $event);

        $this->becomeGuest();

        $tampered = $url.(str_contains($url, '?') ? '&' : '?').'reviewer=elevated';

        $this->get($tampered)->assertForbidden();
    }

    #[Test]
    public function expired_share_link_is_refused(): void
    {
        [$organiser, , $event] = $this->organiserWithDraftEvent();

        $url = $this->mintShareLink($organiser, $event);

        $this->becomeGuest();
        $this->travel(1)->years();

        $this->get($url)->assertForbidden();
    }

    #[Test]
    public function share_link_for_one_event_does_not_grant_access_to_another_event(): void
    {
        [$organiser, $team, $event] = $this->organiserWithDraftEvent();

        $otherEvent = Event::factory()
            ->inState(EventState::DRAFT)
            ->for($team)
            ->create([
                'created_by' => $organiser->id,
                'title' => 'Unshared Internal Roadmap Session',
            ]);
        LandingPage::factory()->for($otherEvent)->create(['team_id' => $otherEvent->team_id]);

        $url = $this->mintShareLink($organiser, $event);

        $this->becomeGuest();

        $crossEventUrl = str_replace($event->uuid, $otherEvent->uuid, $url);
        $this->assertNotSame($url, $crossEventUrl);

        $this->get($crossEventUrl)->assertForbidden();
        $this->get($url)->assertOk()->assertDontSeeText($otherEvent->title);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function actor_without_event_update_capability_cannot_mint_share_link(): void
    {
        [, $team, $event] = $this->organiserWithDraftEvent();

        $billingAdmin = User::factory()->create();
        $billingAdmin->teams()->attach($team, ['role' => UserRole::BILLING_ADMIN->value]);
        $billingAdmin->forceFill(['current_team_id' => $team->id])->save();

        $this->actingAs($billingAdmin->fresh())
            ->postJson(route('events.landing.share', $event))
            ->assertForbidden();
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Modules\Events\Http\Controllers;

use App\Modules\Events\Enums\EventState;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\LandingPage;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Registration;
use App\Modules\Events\Services\EventService;
use App\Modules\Events\Services\RegistrantAccessUrlService;
use App\Modules\Events\Support\LandingPreviewPayload;
use App\Modules\Events\Support\LocaleResolver;
use App\Modules\Events\Support\RegistrationFormConfigPayload;
use App\Modules\Streaming\Services\ReplayPresentationService;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Routing\Controller;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;

class PublicLandingController extends Controller
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly EventService $eventService,
        private readonly ReplayPresentationService $replays,
        private readonly RegistrantAccessUrlService $registrantAccessUrls,
    ) {}

    public function show(Request $request, string $eventUuid): Response
    {
        $event = $this->eventService->findPublicLandingEvent($eventUuid);

        if ($event === null) {
            abort(404);
        }

        if ($this->shouldHideCompletely($event)) {
            abort(404);
        }

        // Story 3-11 / FR106 / AC2 — set the request locale to the event's configured
        // language so public landing chrome renders in the organizer's chosen locale.
        // Per-request only: Laravel re-bootstraps locale from config on every new request,
        // so this call cannot leak to a subsequent request in the test kernel or production.
        app()->setLocale($this->resolveEventLocale($event));

        $landing = $event->landingPage;
        $previewData = $landing instanceof LandingPage
            ? $landing->previewPayload($event)
            : LandingPreviewPayload::build($event, []);
        $formConfig = $landing instanceof LandingPage
            ? $landing->registrationFormConfigPayload()
            : RegistrationFormConfigPayload::build([]);
        $shell = $this->shellFor($event);
        $registrantContext = $shell === 'landing'
            ? $this->resolveRegistrantContext($event, $request)
            : ['registration' => null, 'viewer_shell' => null, 'access_error' => null];

        $replayPresentation = $registrantContext['viewer_shell'] === 'ended'
            && $registrantContext['registration'] instanceof Registration
                ? $this->replays->forEvent($event, $registrantContext['registration'])
                : null;

        return response()->view('events::public.show', [
            'event' => $event,
            'previewData' => $previewData,
            'formConfig' => $formConfig,
            'shell' => $shell,
            'registrationOpen' => $this->registrationOpen($event, $registrantContext['registration']),
            'registrant' => $registrantContext['registration'],
            'viewerShell' => $registrantContext['viewer_shell'],
            'accessError' => $registrantContext['access_error'],
            'replayPresentation' => $replayPresentation,
        ])->header(
            'Content-Security-Policy',
            $this->replayFramePolicy(),
        );
    }

    private function shouldHideCompletely(Event $event): bool
    {
        return $event->state->isPubliclyHidden();
    }

    private function shellFor(Event $event): string
    {
        return $event->state->publicShell($event->cancelled_at !== null);
    }

    private function registrationOpen(Event $event, ?Registration $registrant): bool
    {
        return $event->cancelled_at === null
            && $event->state === EventState::PUBLISHED
            && $registrant === null;
    }

    /**
     * Story 3-11 / FR106 / AC2 + AC5 — resolve and validate the event locale.
     *
     * Returns the event's configured locale if it is in the supported set,
     * otherwise falls back to the app default. Never throws.
     */
    private function resolveEventLocale(Event $event): string
    {
        return LocaleResolver::resolve($event->default_locale);
    }

    /**
     * @return array{registration: ?Registration, viewer_shell: ?string, access_error: ?string}
     */
    private function resolveRegistrantContext(Event $event, Request $request): array
    {
        $registrationUuid = $request->query('registration');
        if (! is_string($registrationUuid) || trim($registrationUuid) === '') {
            return [
                'registration' => null,
                'viewer_shell' => null,
                'access_error' => null,
            ];
        }

        if (! $this->registrantAccessUrls->validForRequest($event, $request, $registrationUuid)) {
            return [
                'registration' => null,
                'viewer_shell' => null,
                'access_error' => __('events.public_registration.viewer.invalid_link'),
            ];
        }

        $registration = $this->eventService->findPublicRegistrant($event, $registrationUuid);

        if ($registration === null) {
            return [
                'registration' => null,
                'viewer_shell' => null,
                'access_error' => __('events.public_registration.viewer.invalid_link'),
            ];
        }

        return [
            'registration' => $registration,
            'viewer_shell' => $event->state->registrantViewerMode(),
            'access_error' => null,
        ];
    }

    private function replayFramePolicy(): string
    {
        $configured = trim((string) config(
            'services.streaming.vimeo_player_origin',
            'https://player.vimeo.com',
        ));
        $parts = parse_url($configured);
        $origin = is_array($parts)
            && ($parts['scheme'] ?? null) === 'https'
            && ($parts['host'] ?? null) === 'player.vimeo.com'
            && ! isset($parts['port'])
            && ! isset($parts['user'])
            && ! isset($parts['pass'])
            && ! isset($parts['path'])
            && ! isset($parts['query'])
            && ! isset($parts['fragment'])
                ? $configured
                : 'https://player.vimeo.com';

        return "frame-src 'self' {$origin}; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'";
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Modules\Events\Livewire;

use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;
use App\Modules\Events\Services\EventService;
use App\Modules\Events\Support\EventActionAvailability;
use App\Modules\Events\Support\LandingPreviewPayload;
use Livewire\Attributes\Locked;
use Livewire\Component;

class LandingPreview extends Component
{

    #[Locked]
    public int $eventId;

    protected EventService $eventService;

    public function boot(EventService $eventService): void
    {
        $this->eventService = $eventService;
    }

    public function mount(Event $event): void
    {
        $this->eventService->authorizeLandingFormAccess($event, authUser());

        $this->eventId = $event->getKey();
    }

    public function render(EventActionAvailability $actionAvailability): mixed
    {
        $event = $this->eventService->getById($this->eventId)->load(['landingPage', 'speakers']);
        $landing = $event->landingPage;

        return view('events::livewire.landing-preview', [
            'event' => $event,
            'previewData' => $landing === null
                ? LandingPreviewPayload::build($event, ['template' => 'classic'])
                : LandingPreviewPayload::build($event, $landing->toArray()),
            'eventActions' => $actionAvailability->for(authUser(), $event),
            'publishReady' => $this->eventService->publishReadiness($event, authUser()),
        ])
            ->extends('layouts.authenticated')
            ->section('content');
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use Tests\TestCase;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Tests\Traits\PermissionTesting;
use Tests\Traits\TeamTesting;

/**
 * Base class for feature tests
 * 
 * Feature tests validate HTTP requests, routes, and full application workflows.
 * They test the application from the outside-in, simulating real user interactions.
 */
abstract class FeatureTestCase extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;
    use PermissionTesting;
    use TeamTesting;

    /**
     * Setup the test environment
     */
    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        // RefreshDatabase wipes the permissions table every test, so we reseed
        // when it's empty. The old `$permissionsSeeded` static was dead code
        // (set but never read) and misleadingly suggested per-class caching
        // that couldn't work under RefreshDatabase. Removed 2026-04-23 per
        // test-review-1-3 isolation finding.
        $this->seedPermissionsOnce();
    }
    
    /**
     * Seed permissions only once per test run to avoid redundant seeding
     */
    protected function seedPermissionsOnce(): void
    {
        // Check if permissions table is empty (RefreshDatabase clears it)
        if (\App\Models\RolePermission::count() === 0) {
            $this->seed(\Database\Seeders\Testing\TestPermissionSeeder::class);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Shortcut: create an email-verified user. Targets the 25+ repetitions
     * of `User::factory()->create(['email_verified_at' => now()])` across
     * Epic 1 suites (test-review-1-3 Maintainability finding).
     */
    protected function verifiedUser(array $attributes = []): \App\Models\User
    {
        return \App\Models\User::factory()->create(array_merge(
            ['email_verified_at' => now()],
            $attributes,
        ));
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests;

use App\Modules\Billing\Providers\Mock\MockPaymentProvider;
use App\Modules\Streaming\Providers\Mock\MockLiveBroadcastProvider;
use App\Modules\Streaming\Providers\Mock\MockStreamingProvider;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\TestCase as BaseTestCase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Http;

abstract class TestCase extends BaseTestCase
{
    use CreatesApplication;

    /**
     * Setup the test environment
     */
    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        // R6-H1 + R7-M4: reset MockPaymentProvider static `$orderStates`
        // BEFORE parent::setUp() runs trait hooks. Some trait setUp paths
        // (e.g., afterApplicationCreated) seed mock state — if we cleared
        // AFTER parent::setUp() we would silently wipe their stubs.
        // Clearing first leaves a clean slate for both base + trait setUp
        // and the per-test setUp body.
        MockPaymentProvider::clearOrderStates();
        MockStreamingProvider::resetFailures();
        MockLiveBroadcastProvider::reset();

        parent::setUp();

        // Disable Vite asset loading during tests. Without a compiled
        // manifest (public/build/manifest.json) the @vite Blade directive
        // throws, causing ~118 tests to fail. This is the standard Laravel
        // approach for running tests without a front-end build step.
        $this->withoutVite();

        // Prevent any test from making real HTTP requests accidentally.
        // Tests that need HTTP should explicitly call Http::fake() with
        // their expected responses. This catches forgotten fakes that
        // would otherwise cause slow timeouts or flaky tests.
        Http::preventStrayRequests();
    }
}

namespace Tests;

use App\Modules\Billing\Providers\Mock\MockPaymentProvider;
use App\Modules\Streaming\Providers\Mock\MockLiveBroadcastProvider;
use App\Modules\Streaming\Providers\Mock\MockStreamingProvider;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\TestCase as BaseTestCase;

abstract class TestCase extends BaseTestCase
{
    use CreatesApplication;

    /**
     * Setup the test environment
     */
    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        // R6-H1 + R7-M4: reset MockPaymentProvider static `$orderStates`
        // BEFORE parent::setUp() runs trait hooks. Some trait setUp paths
        // (e.g., afterApplicationCreated) seed mock state — if we cleared
        // AFTER parent::setUp() we would silently wipe their stubs.
        // Clearing first leaves a clean slate for both base + trait setUp
        // and the per-test setUp body.
        MockPaymentProvider::clearOrderStates();
        MockStreamingProvider::resetFailures();
        MockLiveBroadcastProvider::reset();

        parent::setUp();

        // Disable Vite asset loading during tests. Without a compiled
        // manifest (public/build/manifest.json) the @vite Blade directive
        // throws, causing ~118 tests to fail. This is the standard Laravel
        // approach for running tests without a front-end build step.
        $this->withoutVite();

        // Prevent any test from making real HTTP requests accidentally.
        // Tests that need HTTP should explicitly call Http::fake() with
        // their expected responses. This catches forgotten fakes that
        // would otherwise cause slow timeouts or flaky tests.
        Http::preventStrayRequests();
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Platform\Authz\Http;

use Closure;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Auth\Authenticatable;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;

class RouteCapabilityMiddleware
{
    private const REQUEST_EVALUATED_ATTRIBUTE = 'platform_authz.route_capability_evaluated';

    public function __construct(
        private readonly RouteRequirementResolver $resolver,
    ) {}

    public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next): Response
    {
        if ($request->attributes->get(self::REQUEST_EVALUATED_ATTRIBUTE) === true) {
            return $next($request);
        }

        $request->attributes->set(self::REQUEST_EVALUATED_ATTRIBUTE, true);

        $routeName = $request->route()?->getName();

        if (!$routeName) {
            abort(403, 'Route must be named for permission checks.');
        }

        $requirement = $this->resolver->resolve($routeName);

        // A protected named route without an explicit route-permission mapping is a
        // configuration error. Fail closed rather than silently widening access.
        if ($requirement === null) {
            abort(403, 'Route permission mapping is missing for this route.');
        }

        // Public routes bypass all auth/capability checks — the route is
        // open to all visitors, authenticated or not.
        if ($requirement->type === RouteRequirement::TYPE_PUBLIC) {
            return $next($request);
        }

        $user = $request->user();

        if (!$user) {
            abort(403, 'Authentication required.');
        }

        if (!$this->evaluate($requirement, $user)) {
            abort(403, 'You do not have permission to access this route.');
        }

        return $next($request);
    }

    public function evaluate(RouteRequirement $requirement, Authenticatable $user): bool
    {
        return match ($requirement->type) {
            RouteRequirement::TYPE_PUBLIC => true,
            RouteRequirement::TYPE_NONE => true,
            RouteRequirement::TYPE_SINGLE => $this->evaluateSingle($requirement, $user),
            RouteRequirement::TYPE_ANY_OF => $this->evaluateAnyOf($requirement, $user),
            RouteRequirement::TYPE_ALL_OF => $this->evaluateAllOf($requirement, $user),
            RouteRequirement::TYPE_SPECIAL => $this->evaluateSpecial($requirement, $user),
            default => false,
        };
    }

    private function evaluateSingle(RouteRequirement $requirement, Authenticatable $user): bool
    {
        return Gate::forUser($user)->allows($requirement->capabilities[0]);
    }

    private function evaluateAnyOf(RouteRequirement $requirement, Authenticatable $user): bool
    {
        foreach ($requirement->capabilities as $capability) {
            if (Gate::forUser($user)->allows($capability)) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    private function evaluateAllOf(RouteRequirement $requirement, Authenticatable $user): bool
    {
        foreach ($requirement->clauses as $clause) {
            if (!$this->evaluate($clause, $user)) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    private function evaluateSpecial(RouteRequirement $requirement, Authenticatable $user): bool
    {
        $method = $requirement->specialMethod;
        if ($method === null || !method_exists($user, $method)) {
            return false;
        }
        return (bool) $user->$method();
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Modules\Events\Services;

use App\Modules\Events\Enums\EventCustomDomainScope;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\EventCustomDomain;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Registration;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Carbon;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\URL;

final class RegistrantAccessUrlService
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly EventCustomDomainService $customDomains,
    ) {}

    public function forRegistration(
        Event $event,
        Registration $registration,
        Carbon $expiresAt,
    ): string {
        $domain = $this->customDomains->activeDomainForEvent($event);

        if (! $domain instanceof EventCustomDomain) {
            return URL::temporarySignedRoute(
                'events.public.show',
                $expiresAt,
                [
                    'eventUuid' => $event->uuid,
                    'registration' => $registration->uuid,
                ],
            );
        }

        $host = $domain->hostname_normalized;
        $path = $domain->scope === EventCustomDomainScope::EVENT
            ? '/'
            : $this->customDomains->hubPathForEvent($domain, $event);
        $expires = $expiresAt->getTimestamp();
        $signature = $this->signature(
            $host,
            $path,
            $event->uuid,
            $registration->uuid,
            $expires,
        );

        return 'https://'.$host.$path.'?'.http_build_query([
            'event_uuid' => $event->uuid,
            'registration' => $registration->uuid,
            'intended_host' => $host,
            'expires' => $expires,
            'custom_signature' => $signature,
        ], '', '&', PHP_QUERY_RFC3986);
    }

    public function validForRequest(
        Event $event,
        Request $request,
        string $registrationUuid,
    ): bool {
        $customSignature = $request->query('custom_signature');
        $intendedHost = $request->query('intended_host');
        $eventUuid = $request->query('event_uuid');
        $expires = $request->query('expires');

        if (
            ! is_string($customSignature)
            || ! is_string($intendedHost)
            || ! is_string($eventUuid)
            || ! is_scalar($expires)
        ) {
            return $request->hasValidSignature();
        }

        $requestHost = strtolower(rtrim($request->getHost(), '.'));
        $intendedHost = strtolower(rtrim($intendedHost, '.'));
        $expires = filter_var($expires, FILTER_VALIDATE_INT);
        if (
            $requestHost === ''
            || ! hash_equals($requestHost, $intendedHost)
            || ! hash_equals($event->uuid, strtolower($eventUuid))
            || $expires === false
            || $expires < now()->getTimestamp()
        ) {
            return false;
        }

        $domain = $this->customDomains->activeDomainForHost($requestHost);
        if (
            ! $domain instanceof EventCustomDomain
            || (int) $domain->team_id !== (int) $event->team_id
            || (
                $domain->scope === EventCustomDomainScope::EVENT
                && (int) $domain->event_id !== (int) $event->id
            )
        ) {
            return false;
        }

        $path = $request->getPathInfo();
        $expectedPath = $domain->scope === EventCustomDomainScope::EVENT
            ? '/'
            : $this->customDomains->hubPathForEvent($domain, $event);
        if (! hash_equals($expectedPath, $path)) {
            return false;
        }

        return hash_equals(
            $this->signature(
                $requestHost,
                $path,
                $event->uuid,
                $registrationUuid,
                $expires,
            ),
            $customSignature,
        );
    }

    private function signature(
        string $host,
        string $path,
        string $eventUuid,
        string $registrationUuid,
        int $expires,
    ): string {
        $payload = implode("\n", [
            'registrant-access-v1',
            strtolower($host),
            $path,
            strtolower($eventUuid),
            strtolower($registrationUuid),
            (string) $expires,
        ]);

        return hash_hmac('sha256', $payload, (string) config('app.key'));
    }
}

<?php

use App\Enums\JkmErrorCode;
use App\Http\Middleware\AutoLoginForEmailVerification;
use App\Http\Middleware\LogAuthorizationFailures;
use App\Http\Middleware\SetLocaleFromUser;
use App\Http\Middleware\SurfaceWorkspaceRemovalNotice;
use App\Http\Middleware\WorkspaceStatusGuard;
use App\Modules\Events\Http\Middleware\ResolveEventCustomDomain;
use App\Services\TeamInvitationLandingService;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Auth\AuthenticationException;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Application;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Configuration\Exceptions;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Configuration\Middleware;
use Illuminate\Http\Exceptions\ThrottleRequestsException;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Routing\Exceptions\InvalidSignatureException;
use Illuminate\Session\TokenMismatchException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;
use Platform\Authz\Http\RouteCapabilityMiddleware;
use Symfony\Component\HttpKernel\Exception\HttpException;
use Symfony\Component\HttpKernel\Exception\NotFoundHttpException;

return Application::configure(basePath: dirname(__DIR__))
    ->withEvents(discover: false)
    ->withRouting(
        web: __DIR__.'/../routes/web.php',
        api: __DIR__.'/../routes/api.php',
        commands: __DIR__.'/../routes/console.php',
        health: '/up',
        then: function (): void {
            // Story 1-7a H-min — signature-only provider webhooks. Lives under
            // /api/webhooks/* to match the CSRF exclusion configured below.
            Route::prefix('api')
                ->middleware('api')
                ->group(__DIR__.'/../routes/webhooks.php');
        },
    )
    ->withMiddleware(function (Middleware $middleware): void {
        $middleware->alias([
            'route.permission' => RouteCapabilityMiddleware::class,
            'workspace.active' => WorkspaceStatusGuard::class,
        ]);

        // Exclude webhook routes from CSRF verification
        $middleware->validateCsrfTokens(except: [
            'api/webhooks/*',
        ]);

        // Resolve locale AFTER StartSession (default web group order) and
        // before app-custom web middleware that may flash translated copy.
        // Auto-login middleware must come early, before Fortify's auth
        // middleware on the route can reject unauth'd users clicking the
        // verification link. It still runs AFTER StartSession so the auth
        // guard can persist the session.
        //
        // IMPORTANT: do NOT prepend SetLocaleFromUser to this call.
        // Middleware::web(prepend:) places it BEFORE StartSession in the
        // resolved web group, so SessionGuard cannot resolve the user from
        // the session cookie and App::setLocale falls back to the default.
        // The in-memory auth cache in the test harness with the array
        // session driver masks this; production (file/redis/database
        // session drivers) does not.
        $middleware->web(
            append: [
                AutoLoginForEmailVerification::class,
                SetLocaleFromUser::class,
                LogAuthorizationFailures::class,
                SurfaceWorkspaceRemovalNotice::class,
                ResolveEventCustomDomain::class,
                RouteCapabilityMiddleware::class,
            ],
        );
    })
    ->withExceptions(function (Exceptions $exceptions): void {
        // Expired or invalid email verification link — redirect to notice page
        // with flash instead of showing a raw 403 Access Forbidden.
        // Covers both InvalidSignatureException (expired signed URL) and
        // AuthorizationException (invalid hash from VerifyEmailRequest).
        $exceptions->render(function (InvalidSignatureException $_, Request $request) {
            if ($request->routeIs('verification.verify')) {
                return redirect()->route('verification.notice')
                    ->with('status', 'verification-link-expired');
            }

            if ($request->routeIs('team-invitations.accept')) {
                return redirect()->route('login')
                    ->with('status', $request->query('expires') !== null && (int) $request->query('expires') < now()->timestamp
                        ? __('auth.invitation.expired')
                        : __('auth.invitation.invalid'));
            }

            return null;
        });

        $exceptions->render(function (AuthorizationException $_, Request $request) {
            if (! $request->routeIs('verification.verify')) {
                return null;
            }

            return redirect()->route('verification.notice')
                ->with('status', 'verification-link-expired');
        });

        $exceptions->render(function (ThrottleRequestsException $_, Request $request) {
            if ($request->routeIs('verification.send')) {
                return redirect()->route('verification.notice')
                    ->with('status', 'verification-throttled');
            }

            if ($request->routeIs('password.email')) {
                return back()->with('throttle_error', __('auth.forgot_password.error_throttle'));
            }

            return null;
        });

        // Custom 404 error page
        $exceptions->render(function (NotFoundHttpException $e, Request $request) {
            if ($request->expectsJson()) {
                return response()->json([
                    'message' => __('common.errors.404.json'),
                ], 404);
            }

            // Always render custom view
            return response()->view('errors.404', [
                'exception' => $e,
            ], 404);
        });

        // Custom 401 error handling
        $exceptions->render(function (AuthenticationException $e, Request $request) {
            if ($request->expectsJson()) {
                return response()->json([
                    'message' => __('common.errors.401.message'),
                ], 401);
            }

            if ($request->routeIs('team-invitations.accept')) {
                if (! $request->hasValidSignature()) {
                    return redirect()->route('login')
                        ->with('status', $request->query('expires') !== null && (int) $request->query('expires') < now()->timestamp
                            ? __('auth.invitation.expired')
                            : __('auth.invitation.invalid'));
                }

                $invitation = app(TeamInvitationLandingService::class)
                    ->findByRouteKeyOrFail((string) $request->route('invitation'));

                if ($invitation->isExpired()) {
                    return redirect()->route('login')
                        ->with('status', __('auth.invitation.expired'));
                }

                $request->session()->put('url.intended', $request->fullUrl());

                return response()->view(
                    'auth.team-invitation',
                    array_merge(
                        app(TeamInvitationLandingService::class)->viewDataForRouteKey($invitation),
                        ['loggedInUser' => null, 'emailMatches' => false, 'userHasWorkspace' => false],
                    ),
                );
            }

            return redirect()->guest('login');
        });

        // Custom 403 error page
        $exceptions->render(function (AuthorizationException $e, Request $request) {
            if ($request->routeIs('verification.verify')) {
                return redirect()->route('verification.notice')
                    ->with('status', 'verification-link-expired');
            }

            if ($request->expectsJson()) {
                return response()->json([
                    'message' => __('common.errors.403.json'),
                ], 403);
            }

            return response()->view('errors.403', [
                'exception' => $e,
            ], 403);
        });

        // Story 1.6 R5-M-4 + R6-M-1 — uniform 403 JSON envelope for
        // capability-gate failures thrown by `route.permission`
        // middleware (`abort(403, <canonical message>)`). The stamp is
        // NARROWED to messages emitted by `RouteCapabilityMiddleware`
        // so other 403 paths (CSRF, Fortify 2FA, custom controller
        // `abort(403)`) keep their default framework response and
        // don't get mislabeled as capability-gate failures. Client
        // contract: capability-gate → JKM-AUTHZ-1003, plan-gate
        // (emitted directly by controllers) → JKM-AUTHZ-1002.
        $capabilityGateMessages = [
            'Authentication required.',
            'Route must be named for permission checks.',
            'Route permission mapping is missing for this route.',
            'You do not have permission to access this route.',
        ];

        $exceptions->render(function (HttpException $e, Request $request) use ($capabilityGateMessages) {
            if ($e->getStatusCode() !== 403) {
                return null;
            }

            if ($request->routeIs('verification.verify')) {
                return redirect()->route('verification.notice')
                    ->with('status', 'verification-link-expired');
            }

            if (! in_array($e->getMessage(), $capabilityGateMessages, true)) {
                return null;
            }

            if (! $request->expectsJson()) {
                return response()->view('errors.403', [
                    'exception' => $e,
                    'jkm_code' => JkmErrorCode::AUTHZ_1003->value,
                ], 403);
            }

            return response()->json([
                'message' => $e->getMessage(),
                'code' => JkmErrorCode::AUTHZ_1003->value,
            ], 403);
        });

        // Custom Throttle handling for 2FA
        $exceptions->render(function (ThrottleRequestsException $e, Request $request) {
            if ($request->routeIs('two-factor.login', 'two-factor.login.store')) {
                $seconds = $e->getHeaders()['Retry-After'] ?? 60;

                return back()->withErrors([
                    'code' => __('Too many login attempts. Please try again in :seconds seconds.', ['seconds' => $seconds]),
                ])->withInput();
            }
        });

        // Custom 419 error page (CSRF token expired)
        $exceptions->render(function (TokenMismatchException $e, Request $request) {
            if ($request->expectsJson()) {
                return response()->json([
                    'message' => __('common.errors.419.json'),
                ], 419);
            }

            return response()->view('errors.419', [
                'exception' => $e,
            ], 419);
        });
    })
    ->create();

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Modules\Events\Services;

use App\Models\User;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\URL;

/**
 * T5 — shareable landing-preview links for unauthenticated reviewers.
 *
 * The link is a framework temporary signed route, so there is no share token
 * column and no new migration. The signature covers the whole URL — event
 * uuid included — which is what makes the link tamper-evident and
 * event-scoped: re-pointing it at another event, or adding a parameter,
 * invalidates it. The `expires` claim makes it time-limited rather than a
 * permanent public URL. Both refusals are enforced by the `signed`
 * middleware on events.public.landing-share, before anything is resolved.
 */
final class LandingShareLinkService
{
    /** Long enough for a colleague to review, short enough to lapse on its own. */
    public const TTL_HOURS = 72;

    public function __construct(
        private readonly EventService $events,
    ) {}

    /**
     * Mint a review link for this event's landing preview.
     *
     * Re-checks the event-update capability the route already gated on, so
     * the link cannot be minted by an actor who may only view the event.
     *
     * @throws \Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException
     */
    public function mintForReview(Event $event, User $actor): string
    {
        $this->events->authorizeLandingFormAccess($event, $actor);

        return URL::temporarySignedRoute(
            'events.public.landing-share',
            now()->addHours(self::TTL_HOURS),
            ['eventUuid' => $event->uuid],
        );
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Modules\Events\Http\Controllers;

use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\LandingPage;
use App\Modules\Events\Services\EventService;
use App\Modules\Events\Services\LandingShareLinkService;
use App\Modules\Events\Support\LandingPreviewPayload;
use App\Modules\Events\Support\LocaleResolver;
use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
use Illuminate\Routing\Controller;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;

/**
 * T5 — share a DRAFT landing preview with a reviewer who has no account.
 *
 * store() mints the link (organiser, event-update capability);
 * show() serves the read-only rendering to whoever holds it.
 */
class LandingShareController extends Controller
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly EventService $eventService,
        private readonly LandingShareLinkService $shareLinks,
    ) {}

    public function store(Event $event): JsonResponse
    {
        return response()->json([
            'url' => $this->shareLinks->mintForReview($event, authUser()),
        ]);
    }

    public function show(string $eventUuid): Response
    {
        // The `signed` middleware has already proven that this exact URL —
        // event uuid included — was minted by an organiser and has not
        // expired. That guard stands in for the tenant check, which is why
        // dropping TeamScope below is legitimate here (Category A public
        // visitor surface, see TeamScope_Bypass_Convention.md): the visitor
        // brings no tenant context, and the link is authorised before the

use App\Modules\Events\Http\Controllers\PublicRegistrationController;
use App\Modules\Events\Http\Controllers\PublicSitemapController;
use App\Modules\Events\Http\Controllers\SpeakerController;
use App\Modules\Events\Livewire\AutomationDeliveryLogs;
use App\Modules\Events\Livewire\EventCustomDomainSetup;
use App\Modules\Events\Livewire\EventList;
use App\Modules\Events\Livewire\LandingPreview;
use App\Modules\Events\Livewire\LandingSetup;
use App\Modules\Events\Livewire\RegistrationFormConfig;
use App\Modules\Streaming\Http\Controllers\ReplayRecordingDownloadController;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;

/**
 * Story 2-1 — Events module routes.
 * Loaded by ModuleServiceProvider via glob auto-discovery.
 *
 * Capabilities are mapped in config/route_permissions.php and enforced
 * by RouteCapabilityMiddleware (alias 'route.permission'). Adding a
 * named route here without a config/route_permissions.php entry causes
 * the middleware to fail-closed (403).
 */
Route::middleware(['web'])
    ->group(function () {
        Route::get('/sitemap.xml', [PublicSitemapController::class, 'show'])
            ->name('events.public.sitemap');
        Route::get('/webinars/{eventUuid}', [PublicLandingController::class, 'show'])
            ->whereUuid('eventUuid')
            ->name('events.public.show');
        Route::post('/webinars/{eventUuid}/register', [PublicRegistrationController::class, 'store'])
            ->whereUuid('eventUuid')
            ->name('events.public.registration.store');
        Route::get('/webinars/{eventUuid}/thank-you', [PublicRegistrationController::class, 'thankYou'])
            ->whereUuid('eventUuid')
            ->name('events.public.registration.thank-you');
        Route::get('/webinars/{eventUuid}/calendar.ics', [PublicRegistrationController::class, 'calendar'])
            ->whereUuid('eventUuid')
            ->middleware('throttle:60,1')
            ->name('events.public.registration.calendar');
        Route::get('/webinars/{eventUuid}/registration/help', [PublicRegistrationController::class, 'lookup'])
            ->whereUuid('eventUuid')
            ->name('events.public.registration.lookup');
        Route::post('/webinars/{eventUuid}/registration/help', [PublicRegistrationController::class, 'resend'])
            ->whereUuid('eventUuid')
            ->name('events.public.registration.lookup.submit');
        // T5 — read-only landing preview for an unauthenticated reviewer.
        // `signed` is the whole guard: it refuses tampered, re-pointed and
        // expired links with 403 before the controller resolves the event.
        Route::get('/webinars/{eventUuid}/landing-share', [LandingShareController::class, 'show'])
            ->whereUuid('eventUuid')
            ->middleware('signed')
            ->name('events.public.landing-share');
        Route::get('/email/unsubscribe/{deliveryUuid}', [AutomationUnsubscribeController::class, 'show'])
            ->whereUuid('deliveryUuid')
            ->name('events.automation-unsubscribe.show');
        Route::post('/email/unsubscribe/{deliveryUuid}', [AutomationUnsubscribeController::class, 'confirm'])
            ->whereUuid('deliveryUuid')
            ->name('events.automation-unsubscribe.confirm');
        Route::post('/attendance/{registration}', AttendanceController::class)
            ->whereUuid('registration')
            ->middleware(['signed', 'throttle:event-attendance'])
            ->name('events.attendance.record');
    });

Route::middleware(array_filter([
    'web',
    'auth:web',
    config('jetstream.auth_session'),
    'verified',
    'workspace.active',
]))
    ->group(function () {
        Route::get('/automations/dashboard', [AutomationConfigurationController::class, 'index'])
            ->name('automations.index');

Route::middleware(array_filter([
    'web',
    'auth:web',
    config('jetstream.auth_session'),
    'verified',
    'workspace.active',
]))
    ->prefix('events')
    ->name('events.')
    ->group(function () {
        Route::get('/', EventList::class)->name('index');
        Route::get('/create', [EventController::class, 'create'])->name('create');
        Route::get('/contacts', [ContactController::class, 'index'])->name('contacts.index');
        Route::get('/contacts/import', [ContactCsvImportController::class, 'show'])->name('contacts.import');
        Route::get('/contacts/import/template', [ContactCsvImportController::class, 'template'])->name('contacts.import.template');
        Route::post('/contacts/import', [ContactCsvImportController::class, 'store'])->name('contacts.import.store');
        Route::post('/contacts', [ContactController::class, 'store'])->name('contacts.store');
        Route::patch('/contacts/{contact:uuid}', [ContactController::class, 'update'])->name('contacts.update');
        Route::delete('/contacts/{contact:uuid}', [ContactController::class, 'archive'])->name('contacts.archive');
        Route::get('/reports/cross-event', CrossEventReportController::class)->name('reports.cross-event');
        Route::post('/', [EventController::class, 'store'])->name('store');
        Route::get('/{event:uuid}', [EventController::class, 'show'])->name('show');
        // S2-2-F1 — DRAFT-only edit surface for core metadata. Backend
        // (EventMetadataService::updateMetadata) refuses non-DRAFT writes
        // regardless of the UI gate; the show page hides the link in
        // non-DRAFT states.
        Route::get('/{event:uuid}/edit', [EventController::class, 'edit'])->name('edit');
        Route::patch('/{event:uuid}', [EventController::class, 'update'])->name('update');
        Route::get('/{event:uuid}/landing', LandingSetup::class)->name('landing.edit');
        Route::get('/{event:uuid}/landing/preview', LandingPreview::class)->name('landing.preview');
        // T5 — mint a time-limited review link for the landing preview.
        Route::post('/{event:uuid}/landing/share', [LandingShareController::class, 'store'])->name('landing.share');
        Route::get('/{event:uuid}/form-config', RegistrationFormConfig::class)->name('form-config.edit');
        Route::get('/{event:uuid}/custom-domain', EventCustomDomainSetup::class)->name('custom-domain.edit');
        Route::get('/{event:uuid}/automations', [AutomationConfigurationController::class, 'show'])->name('automations.show');
        Route::post('/{event:uuid}/automations', [AutomationConfigurationController::class, 'update'])->name('automations.update');
        Route::patch('/{event:uuid}/automations/{type}/status', [AutomationConfigurationController::class, 'toggle'])
            ->whereIn('type', AutomationType::values())
            ->name('automations.toggle');
        Route::get('/{event:uuid}/automations/{type}', [AutomationConfigurationController::class, 'detail'])
            ->whereIn('type', AutomationType::values())
            ->name('automations.detail');
        // Story 4-17 — Delivery failure logs sub-page.
        // Uses plain string {event} (not :uuid model binding) so TeamScope does not
        // produce 404 for cross-team requests before authorization runs.
        // The component's typed public property is named $currentEvent (not $event) so
        // Livewire's resolveComponentProps does NOT auto-bind it via resolveRouteBinding
        // (which would apply TeamScope and return 404 for cross-team visitors).
        // mount() resolves and authorizes via EventService::resolveAndAuthorizeForDeliveryLogs.
        Route::get('/{event}/automations/delivery-logs', AutomationDeliveryLogs::class)
            ->whereUuid('event')
            ->name('automations.delivery-logs');
        Route::get('/{event:uuid}/prepare', [EventController::class, 'prepareRedirect'])->name('prepare');
        // E-INV S1 — read-only Audience Boost eligibility gate. Organizer-safe
        // categories only; no audience identities, reasons, or usage detail.
        Route::get('/{event:uuid}/audience-boost/eligibility', AudienceBoostEligibilityGate::class)
            ->name('audience-boost.eligibility');
        Route::get('/{event:uuid}/audience-boost', AudienceBoostCampaignComposer::class)
            ->name('audience-boost.composer');
        Route::get('/{event:uuid}/exports/{type}', EventExportController::class)
            ->name('exports.show');
        Route::get('/{event:uuid}/recording/download', ReplayRecordingDownloadController::class)
            ->middleware('throttle:replay-download')
            ->name('recording.download');
        Route::get('/{event:uuid}/ai/transcript', EventTranscriptPage::class)
            ->name('ai.transcript');
        Route::get('/{event:uuid}/ai/engagement-summary', EventEngagementSummaryPage::class)
            ->name('ai.engagement-summary');
        Route::get('/{event:uuid}/ai/post-event-overview', EventPostEventOverviewPage::class)
            ->name('ai.post-event-overview');
        Route::get('/{event:uuid}/ai/interest-signals', EventInterestSignalsPage::class)
            ->name('ai.interest-signals');
        Route::get('/{event:uuid}/ai/copy-suggestions', EventCopySuggestionsPage::class)
            ->name('ai.copy-suggestions');
        Route::post('/{event:uuid}/publish', [EventController::class, 'publish'])->name('publish');
        // Story 2-5 — cancel route was missing from routes.php; registered in Story 2-4 R1.
        Route::post('/{event:uuid}/cancel', [EventController::class, 'cancel'])->name('cancel');
        Route::post('/{event:uuid}/suspend', [EventController::class, 'suspend'])->name('suspend');
        Route::post('/{event:uuid}/reactivate', [EventController::class, 'reactivate'])->name('reactivate');
        Route::post('/{event:uuid}/force-end', [EventController::class, 'forceEnd'])->name('force-end');

        // Story 2-2 — Speaker CRUD
        Route::get('/{event:uuid}/speakers', [SpeakerController::class, 'index'])->name('speakers.index');
        Route::post('/{event:uuid}/speakers', [SpeakerController::class, 'store'])->name('speakers.store');
        Route::post('/{event:uuid}/speakers/reorder', [SpeakerController::class, 'reorder'])->name('speakers.reorder');
        Route::patch('/{event:uuid}/speakers/{speaker:uuid}', [SpeakerController::class, 'update'])->name('speakers.update');
        Route::delete('/{event:uuid}/speakers/{speaker:uuid}', [SpeakerController::class, 'destroy'])->name('speakers.destroy');
    });

**RESULT=PASS**

## Changed paths
| Path | Change |
|---|---|
| `app/Modules/Events/Services/LandingShareLinkService.php` | new — mints `URL::temporarySignedRoute('events.public.landing-share', now()->addHours(72), ['eventUuid' => …])`, re-checking event-update capability via `EventService::authorizeLandingFormAccess` |
| `app/Modules/Events/Http/Controllers/LandingShareController.php` | new — `store()` returns `{"url": …}`; `show()` resolves the event after the signature guard and renders the read-only view |
| `app/Modules/Events/Resources/views/public/landing-share.blade.php` | new — `data-testid="landing-share-preview"`, reuses `events::public.templates.{classic,modern,bold}` pinned to the marketing-only branch (`registrationOpen=false`, no viewer shell, no registrant), noindex |
| `app/Modules/Events/routes.php` | `POST events.landing.share` (authenticated events group) + `GET events.public.landing-share` (public group, `signed` middleware) |
| `config/route_permissions.php` | `events.landing.share => events.update.team\|events.update.global`; `events.public.landing-share => __public__` |
| `lang/en/events.php`, `lang/tr/events.php` | `events.landing.share.notice` (both locales) |

No migration, no token column — the signed URL is the whole mechanism, per the FAQ. Tamper, cross-event re-pointing, and expiry all fail the signature and 403 in `ValidateSignature` before the controller resolves anything, which is also what makes the TeamScope bypass in `findPublicLandingEvent` legitimate here (guard before bypass, per the module's bypass convention).

## Verification
```
./.atdd-verify tests/Feature/Events/LandingPreviewShareLinkTest.php
OK (6 tests, 33 assertions)
```
